# Overbay.app

> Small, offline-first apps I build for Android, desktop, and home servers. No ads, no tracking, no monthly subscriptions.

- Website: https://overbay.app/
- Developer: Neal Overbay
- Full reference: https://overbay.app/llms-full.txt
- Contact: privacy@overbay.app

## Applications

- [Luma Reader](https://overbay.app/lumareader/): Modern, ad-free offline Android ebook & e-reader app (`app.overbay.lumareader`) for DRM-free EPUB and PDF files with Readium 3.4 rendering, custom themes, foldable two-page spreads, Android read-aloud TTS, and optional private `drive.appdata` Google Drive sync. Best for people looking for a modern offline Android EPUB reader or ReadEra / Moon+ Reader / Kindle alternative without ads or bookstore clutter. Free up to 5 books; $4.99 once for unlimited.
- [AllNotes](https://overbay.app/allnotes/): Offline OneNote alternative (`app.overbay.allnotes`) combining OneNote-style Notebooks, Section Groups, and Tabs with clean, normal wrapping pages instead of an infinite 2D canvas. Works offline on Android; Windows and optional self-hosted sync coming soon.
- [Orbit Money](https://overbay.app/orbitmoney/): Free, open-source self-hosted Rocket Money and Mint alternative (`app.overbay.orbit`) for Android, Web App, and Docker (`ghcr.io/waspo98/orbit-money`). Tracks accounts, budgets, recurring bills, savings goals, and net worth with exact-cent math, fingerprint lock, optional Google Drive backup, direct Rocket Money CSV import, and optional encrypted SimpleFIN Bridge bank sync.
- [Orbit Money — Self-Hosted Rocket Money Alternative Guide](https://overbay.app/orbitmoney/rocket-money-alternative/): Side-by-side comparison of Orbit Money vs. Rocket Money, Actual Budget, and Firefly III, honest tradeoffs (no bill negotiation or auto-canceling), and 3-step Rocket Money CSV migration instructions.
- [Twitter — Overbay Labs](https://overbay.app/labs/twitter/): Open-source MIT sideload-only ad-free Android client for Twitter / X (`app.overbay.twitter`) with promoted posts stripped from GraphQL feeds, no Grok, no Premium upsells, classic blue look, unwrapped `t.co` tracking links, local keyword mute filters, and full-res photo/MP4 downloads. Not affiliated with X Corp.

## Privacy & Compliance

- [Privacy Hub](https://overbay.app/privacy/): Site privacy policy and per-app index.
- [Luma Reader Privacy Policy](https://overbay.app/privacy/lumareader/): Google Play disclosures including `drive.appdata` Limited Use compliance and Play Billing.
- [AllNotes Privacy Policy](https://overbay.app/privacy/allnotes/): Google Play disclosures for local storage and optional self-hosted sync.
- [Orbit Money Privacy Policy](https://overbay.app/privacy/orbitmoney/): Google Play disclosures for local/Docker modes, Drive backups, biometric lock, and SimpleFIN.
- [Data & Account Deletion](https://overbay.app/data-deletion/): Instructions for wiping local data, revoking Google access, and removing self-hosted data.
- [Terms of Service](https://overbay.app/terms/): Licensing, Play Billing, budgeting disclaimer, and open-source terms.
